lineage_id.description: ID of the lineage to display

ac_index.description: AC index (1-based) for 'ac' mode. Required when mode='ac'.

view.description: Verbosity: 'tree' (default) for the full AC tree, 'summary' for a short monitor, or 'compact' for one-line polling.

max_nodes.description: Maximum tree nodes to render when view='tree'.

attach_execution.description: Attach an externally verified execution id to an unknown run handoff

attach_job.description: Attach an externally verified job id to an unknown run handoff

attach_session.description: Attach an externally verified run session id to an unknown run handoff

attach_source.description: Source label for an attached run handle

reconcile_run.description: Try to reconcile an unknown run handoff without starting a duplicate run

reconcile_source.description: Source label for run handoff reconciliation

pipeline_timeout_seconds.description: Top-level pipeline deadline in seconds. Defaults to 7200s for new sessions. Range: 60-86400. Cannot be changed on resume; the deadline is preserved across process restarts.

user_preferences.description: Caller-supplied user preferences keyed by ledger section name (e.g. runtime_context, constraints, non_goals). The Driver tags matching answers with [from-auto][user_preference] in the ledger. Keys must be valid ledger section names; values must be non-empty strings or non-empty lists of strings/numbers. On resume, null/empty values clear the persisted preference for that section.

efficiency_mode.description: Execution efficiency policy: adaptive may use lower-cost child tiers with recovery escalation; quality_first keeps child ACs at the parent starting tier. When omitted on a fresh start, a configured execution.default_policy supplies it (default quality_first; adaptive only when the policy is ask).

frugality_assurance.description: Frugality assurance: off, observe, or explicitly authorized strict. Defaults from efficiency_mode and is immutable on resume.

complete_product.description: Deprecated and ignored. The run job owns run -> evaluate -> ralph; follow it with ouroboros_job_status or ouroboros_job_wait instead.

domain.description: Optional domain profile name (for example, coding)

commit_policy.description: Checkpoint commit policy: ac_checkpoint, final_only, or none

worktree_policy.description: Worktree isolation policy: auto, always, current, or none

action.description: Action to perform: 'scan' to discover repos from ~/, 'register' to add a single repo, 'query' to list all registered repos from the DB without rescanning, get the default, or rank repos by 'text', 'set_default' to toggle a repo's default flag (supports multiple defaults; does NOT clear others). Auto-detected from parameters when omitted.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path of the repository. Required for 'register' and 'set_default' actions.

name.description: Human-readable name for the repository. Used with 'register'. Defaults to directory name.

desc.description: One-line description of the repository. Used with 'register'. Optional.

is_default.description: For 'set_default' action: set to true to mark as default, false to unmark. Defaults to true.

default_only.description: When true with 'query' action, return only the default repo instead of the full list. Defaults to false.

scan_root.description: Existing directory to walk for the 'scan' action. Defaults to the current user's home directory.

indices.description: Comma-separated repo numbers from the scan list (e.g. '6,18,19'). Used with 'set_defaults' action to replace all defaults at once.

text.description: Free-text topic for the 'query' action. When set, repos are ranked by BM25 relevance over name, description, path, manifest, README head, and top-level entries stored at scan time; only matching repos are returned, best first. offset/limit then page the ranked list (limit defaults to 10).

offset.description: Number of rows to skip for 'query' pagination. Defaults to 0.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return for 'query' pagination. Omit for no limit.

job_id.description: Job ID returned by a start tool

session_id.description: The execution session ID being verified

seed_content.description: Seed YAML containing acceptance_criteria, goal, constraints. The seed's acceptance_criteria list is evaluated in full.

artifact.description: The Run output/artifact to verify against the seed's ACs

artifact_type.description: Type of artifact: code, docs, config. Default: code

session_id.description: The execution session ID to evaluate

seed_content.description: Original seed YAML for goal/constraints extraction

acceptance_criterion.description: Specific acceptance criterion to evaluate against

acceptance_criteria.description: Multiple acceptance criteria for checklist evaluation. When two or more items are provided, each AC is evaluated independently and the results are aggregated into a pass/fail checklist (#366). Overrides acceptance_criterion.

artifact_type.description: Type of artifact: code, docs, config. Default: code

trigger_consensus.description: Force Stage 3 consensus evaluation. Default: False

working_dir.description: Project root used to resolve Stage 1 mechanical verification commands and Stage 2 source-file visibility. Commands are read from .ouroboros/mechanical.toml; when the file is missing, the evaluator makes one AI detect call that inspects manifests (package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, Makefile, ...) and authors the toml. Stage 1 skips every check when no toml is produced — it never guesses.

parallel.description: Whether to run ACs in parallel. True (default): parallel execution (fast, may cause import conflicts). False: sequential execution (slower, more stable code generation).

model_tier.description: Model-tier routing: small/medium/large → frugal/standard/frontier execution tier (trusted decomposed children may run one tier below; retries escalate). Omit to preserve automatic runtime selection; pass medium explicitly to pin standard routing.

auto_evolve.description: Override execution.auto_evolve for the chained evaluation. When true, an explicitly rejected evaluation starts a bounded Ralph continuation loop.

conductor_decision_id.description: Selected conductor decision receipt authorizing a fresh successor.

predecessor_execution_id.description: Execution ID that the new successor follows.

conductor_directive.description: Bounded corrective context copied exactly from the selected conductor decision. Fresh successor executions only.

contract_id.description: The contract_id from a disposable artifact envelope. Omit it and pass lane_id alone to list instead: that lane's own recent findings in this project, newest first, as contract_ids to read back with this same tool.

lane_id.description: Optional. Narrows a fan-out artifact to the output of one lane, returning that lane's body alone. Pass the lane_id offered beside the contract_id; omit it to read the whole artifact. A supplied lane the artifact does not carry is an error, never a broader read.

session_id.description: Interview session ID to convert to a seed. Required unless session_context is provided.

session_context.description: Interview-less path: settled material from THIS session. Keys: goal (required), acceptance_criteria (required, verifiable checks), constraints, decisions (become constraints), project_type. Anchored verbatim — supply the user's own settled wording, never your paraphrase.

ambiguity_score.description: Ambiguity score for the interview (0.0 = clear, 1.0 = ambiguous). Required if interview didn't calculate it. Generation fails if > 0.2.

client_gates.description: Client-side interview gates acknowledged before seed generation. Expected values include seed_ready_acceptance_guard and restate_goal_approved.

force.description: Bypass the ambiguity-score threshold and generate the seed even when ambiguity_score > 0.2. Mirrors the CLI 'Generate Seed anyway' opt-in: the real score is still recorded in seed metadata for provenance, and the bypass is emitted to the audit log. Defaults to false.

initial_context.description: Initial context to start a new interview session

session_id.description: Session ID to resume an existing interview

answer.description: Response to the current interview question

cwd.description: Working directory for brownfield auto-detection. Defaults to the current working directory if not provided.

last_question.description: The question text from the previous child session's response. In plugin mode each dispatch creates a new child session whose questions are not automatically persisted server-side. Pass the child's last question here when submitting an answer so the interview transcript preserves the real question text instead of a placeholder.

interview_id.description: Optional caller-supplied id for a brand-new interview. Must match the server format 'interview_<16 lowercase hex>' and must NOT collide with an existing interview file. Only valid for the start action — supplying it together with session_id (resume) or answer is rejected with an error to prevent silent identifier hijacking; do not preserve this argument across turns. Used by the bounded auto driver to pre-allocate the id so a driver-level cancel cannot leave auto state out of sync with the persisted interview file (see Q00/ouroboros#687).

confused_terms.description: Explicit domain terms the user says they do not understand. Queued on the start turn and applied only after the first answer.

references.description: Bounded user-provided reference cues. Each object requires reference_id, label, and origin; url/excerpt are optional.

calibration_input.description: User-reported topic knowledge for session-local interview wording. This does not answer a pending question.

interview_calibration.description: Validated session-local language calibration transported by the runtime handle; it is not persisted in interview state.

job_id.description: Job ID returned by a start tool
Job ID returned by a start tool
Job ID returned by a start tool

cursor.description: Previous cursor from job_status or job_wait

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a change. Defaults to 0 so the tool returns an immediate snapshot and never holds the MCP client open unless the caller explicitly asks for long-polling. Values above 5 are capped so clients with MCP tool-call timeouts can poll safely.

stream.description: 'progress' (default) watches job/execution progress; 'linked' also streams linked session, lineage, and subagent events.

wait_for.description: 'raw' (default) returns on any job event, preserving existing behavior; 'ac_change' waits for AC/Sub-AC/phase progress or terminal status; 'attention_or_ac_change' additionally wakes for Synapse delivery status; 'phase_change' waits for phase transitions or terminal status; 'terminal' waits only for terminal status.

problem_context.description: Description of the stuck situation or problem

current_approach.description: What has been tried so far that isn't working

persona.description: Single persona (hacker, researcher, simplifier, architect, contrarian) OR 'all' to dispatch ALL 5 personas in parallel as separate Task panes.

stagnation_pattern.description: Detected stagnation pattern used to suggest a persona when persona is omitted.

personas.description: Explicit list of personas to dispatch in parallel. Takes precedence over 'persona' arg. Example: ['hacker','contrarian','architect']. Each runs in its own parallel Task pane.

failed_attempts.description: Previous failed approaches to avoid repeating

session_id.description: Interview/lateral session id the fan-out belongs to. The id is recorded with the fan-out so a later ouroboros_submit_fanout_results from a different session is refused.

mode.description: 'unstuck' (default): break through stagnation. 'decision': personas advise on a consequential choice; problem_context describes the options, current_approach the currently favored one (or 'undecided'). The fan-out synthesis contract then requires ONE recommendation, its grounds, the strongest dissent, and flip conditions.

research.description: Deep tier opt-in: personas ground claims with web evidence when their runtime exposes web tools, and emit a machine-readable evidence block. Slower; never the default. Runtimes without web tools degrade to opinion-only instead of failing.

lineage_id.description: ID of the lineage to query

session_id.description: The execution session ID to measure drift for

current_output.description: Current execution output to measure drift against the seed goal

seed_content.description: Original seed YAML content for drift calculation

current_concepts.description: Concepts present in the current output (for ontology drift)

initial_context.description: Initial product description to start a new PM interview

session_id.description: Session ID to resume an existing PM interview

answer.description: PM's response to a single-question turn. Pass the question it answers as 'last_question'. This singular form is mutually exclusive with 'answers'; for a turn that asked more than one question, use 'answers' instead.

answers.description: A turn's answers, sent together: [{question, answer}, ...], one entry per question the turn asked. This batch form is mutually exclusive with 'answer'. A turn is recorded whole, so collect every answer before calling. Each entry names its own question and the batch accepts one to three entries.

action.description: Action to perform. Auto-detected from parameter presence when omitted: initial_context → 'start', session_id + answer → 'resume'. Use 'generate' explicitly to produce PM seed from completed interview.

cwd.description: Working directory for PM document output. Defaults to current working directory. Brownfield context is loaded from DB (is_default=true).

selected_repos.description: List of repository paths selected for brownfield context (2-step start: returned by step 1, sent back in step 2). All repos are assigned role=main. When provided with initial_context, starts the interview with the selected brownfield repos.

last_question.description: The question this answer is answering. A turn persists nothing when it asks, on any runtime, so an answer without its question is refused — there is no remembered question to file it under, and the round behind it is one somebody already answered.

project_dir.description: Project or workspace directory. Defaults to the MCP server caller directory captured at startup.

limit.description: Complete-run safety cap. The query fails instead of truncating when the matching population exceeds this value.

artifact.description: The artifact content to evaluate (code, text, JSON, etc.)

quality_bar.description: Natural language description of what 'pass' means. E.g., 'All public functions must have type hints and docstrings.'

artifact_type.description: Type of artifact: code, api_response, document, screenshot, test_output, custom. Default: code

reference.description: Optional reference artifact for comparison (expected output, target schema, reference description).

pass_threshold.description: Score threshold for pass verdict (0.0-1.0). Default: 0.80

qa_session_id.description: QA session ID for multi-iteration tracking. If omitted, a new session is created.

iteration_history.description: Previous iteration results for loop context (JSON array).

seed_content.description: Optional seed YAML for additional context (goal, constraints).

session_id.description: Filter events by session ID. If not provided, returns events across all sessions.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Default: 50

offset.description: Number of events to skip for pagination. Default: 0

session_id.description: Optional orchestrator session ID to project.

execution_id.description: Optional execution aggregate ID. When session_id is also provided, this narrows related session-event lookup.

seed_id.description: Optional seed ID override. If omitted, the handler derives one from events and falls back to the queried ID.

limit.description: Optional safety cap for related events. If the run has more events than this cap, the tool fails instead of returning a partial projection.

lineage_id.description: Lineage ID to start or continue.

seed_content.description: Seed YAML content for generation 1. Omit for continuation.

execute.description: Whether each generation should execute and evaluate. Default: true.

parallel.description: Whether each generation may execute ACs in parallel. Default: true.

project_dir.description: Project root forwarded to each evolve_step generation.

commit_policy.description: Optional checkpoint commit policy forwarded to evolve_step.

auto_session_id.description: Optional auto session id used for checkpoint commit metadata.

execution_id.description: Optional execution id used for checkpoint commit metadata.

checkpoint_commits.description: Existing checkpoint commit records forwarded to evolve_step.

checkpoint_attempted_ac_ids.description: Acceptance criteria already considered for checkpoint commits.

max_generations.description: Maximum generations to run before stopping. Default: 10. Range: 1-10.

per_iteration_timeout_seconds.description: Per-iteration wall-clock bound in seconds. In-process runtime: hard-enforced via asyncio.timeout, the loop stops with stop_reason='iteration_timeout' on expiry. OpenCode plugin runtime: advisory bound advertised to the child session via prompt + subagent context — the child is expected to honor it and return stop_reason='iteration_timeout', but the parent MCP process cannot interrupt the child, so a non-conforming child session may still exceed this bound. Default: 1800. Range: 30-7200.

oscillation_window.description: Number of trailing iterations whose findings_hash must match (and QA must not have passed) to stop with stop_reason='oscillation_detected'. Default: 3. Range: 2-10. Values < 2 are rejected because a single iteration cannot oscillate with itself.

grade_regression_window.description: Number of trailing iterations whose non-None grades must strictly decrease to stop with stop_reason='grade_regressing'. Default: 2. Range: 2-10. Values < 2 are rejected because strict-decrease requires at least two grades to compare.

max_total_seconds.description: Total wall-clock budget for the entire Ralph loop in seconds. In the in-process runner this is enforced by RalphLoopRunner: checked at the top of every iteration BEFORE launching evolve_step, and on exhaustion the loop stops with stop_reason='wall_clock_exhausted'. In OpenCode plugin mode the bound is forwarded to the child session and the plugin is expected to self-enforce; the MCP server cannot abort a foreign child process. When omitted, a derived ceiling of max_generations * per_iteration_timeout_seconds is auto-applied (with a WARNING log) for standalone callers. Range: 1-86400.

When omitted, a derived ceiling of max_generations * per_iteration_timeout_seconds is auto-applied (with a WARNING log) for standalone callers. Range: 1-86400.

conductor_decision_id.description: Selected conductor decision authorizing one successor generation.

predecessor_execution_id.description: Execution or generation that this successor follows.

conductor_directive.description: Deterministic non-relaxing directive for one successor generation.

session_id.description: Interview/lateral session id. Supply the exact session_id stamped in the originating fan-out when one was registered; omit only when that fan-out has no session binding. An omitted value does not bypass a registered binding.

fanout_id.description: The fanout_id stamped into the originating tool's meta.

correlation_key.description: The result_correlation_key from the originating meta (e.g. 'context.persona' or 'code_facts'). Supply the exact registered value when present; omit only when the fan-out has no correlation binding. Omission does not bypass a registered binding.

results.description: Correlated child outputs: objects with a 'key' (the correlation value) and a 'content' (the child result), or 'undispatched': true when the child never ran.
